seo.title: Plugin catalog — OpenMixer
seo.description: What OpenMixer measured about {count} audio plugins on {day}: stability, real-time safety, CPU cost, latency, and whether each runs in-process.
seo.entryDescription: {name}: {verdict} in the OpenMixer plugin catalog run of {day}.
seo.entryDescriptionVendor: {name} by {vendor}: {verdict} in the OpenMixer plugin catalog run of {day}.

in-process.label: In-process
in-process.meaning: Passed every measured dimension. Qualified to run inside the engine’s own process.

isolated.label: Isolated
isolated.meaning: Runs, in a separate process. The deciding reason says why it is not in-process.

unknown.label: Not fully measured
unknown.meaning: At least one dimension was not measured, so no verdict is given. Runs in a separate process.

refused.label: Refused
refused.meaning: The qualifier could not load or run it.

source.console: the verdicts a running console ({producer}) held on that date

hero.title: What we measured about each plugin.
hero.lede: Each plugin is loaded, run and measured before the console hosts it: stability over repeated load cycles and a long soak, allocations, locks and system calls in the audio callback, CPU cost, latency and its inputs and outputs. These are the results of the run of {day}, at {rate} Hz and {quantum} frames, taken from {source}.

effects.title: {count} effects
effects.lede: Plugins that process a channel or a bus. Select a plugin for every reason behind its verdict.

instruments.title: {count} instruments
instruments.lede: Instruments are for playing parts from the console, such as a MIDI sequence at a set clock and tempo. They are listed with the same measurements and are not ranked against effects.
instruments.none: No instrument was part of this run.

others.title: {count} other plugins
others.lede: Analysers, generators and utilities, as the plugins declare themselves.

reading.title: What each verdict means.
reading.threshold: A dimension counts as measured only past its threshold: {cycles} load cycles, a {hours}-hour soak, and a CPU cost of at most {ceiling} of one core at the 95th percentile. The worst dimension decides the verdict.

data.title: Where these figures come from.
data.one: Every figure on these pages is generated from one run file, published with its schema. The same file is installed on consoles by the openmixer-plugin-catalog package.
data.schema: The schema and how the fields are derived
data.two: A result is for the package version and date shown on the plugin’s page. If you maintain a plugin and an entry is wrong or out of date, each plugin page has a link to report it.

entry.notFound: No such plugin in the catalog
entry.footerPackage: This entry is for {what}, measured on {day}. If you maintain this plugin and something here is wrong or out of date, tell us.
entry.footerBinary: the binary installed on the test machine
